Th.core_label: n<=4 shells common core (60e, small-core An standard per the Ce 28e decision); Z_eff = 30; valence 5s 5p 5d 6s 6p + 5f 6d 7s
Th.hamiltonian: Dirac-Coulomb + Breit (rci transverse photon, low-frequency limit; no QED, no mass shifts); rmcdhf EAL, (2J+1) weights, all levels
Th.comment: Energy-consistent fit set for Th, configuration averages ((2J+1)-weighted, all levels), DC+Breit, matched to ATSP hf TERM=AV. Anchor: Th4+ [Rn]. Neutral grounds on 6d2 7s2 (5f higher), Th3+ on 5f. GRASP core Xe; 4f 5d 6s 6p carried inactive in the peel. Z=90 lesson (the false-vacuum saga, see lab log 2026-07-07): TF and hydrogenic rmcdhf estimates converge Th into a spurious SCF fixed point ~9 eV high that is stationary and reproducible; every state is therefore seeded from converged nonrel ATSP hf orbitals via rwfnmchfmcdf (atsp_hf_seed), which lands in the true basin single-shot. Third lesson: the nonrel->rel converted 5f- estimate defeats the rmcdhf solve unpredictably, so ALL 5f-carrying states file-seed (estimate_from) from a converged true-basin f-neighbor; hf_seed covers the f-free states. Fourth: above ion1 the 7s must descend charge state by charge state (file-seed from the ion below, vary_first 7s).

U.hamiltonian: Dirac-Coulomb + Breit (rci transverse photon, low-frequency limit; no QED, no mass shifts); rmcdhf EAL, (2J+1) weights, all levels
U.comment: Energy-consistent fit set for U, configuration averages ((2J+1)-weighted, all levels), DC+Breit, matched to ATSP hf TERM=AV. Anchor: U6+ [Rn]. Ladder mirrors Th with U's f3-centric filling: neutral grounds on 5f3 6d 7s2, U+ on 5f3 7s2, U3+ on 5f3, U5+ on 5f1. All Th seeding rules applied: f-free states seed from converted nonrel ATSP hf orbitals (atsp_hf_seed); 5f-carrying states file-seed from a converged true-basin f-neighbor (the converted nonrel 5f defeats the rmcdhf solve, and the nonrel/rel 5f gap only grows at Z=92); ion5_5f1 births 5f via method-3 fill + vary_first above the anchor; 7s is born at ion2 in the f3 chain and descends by file-seed. 6d births are staged (vary_first) like the 5f birth -- an unstaged hydrogenic 6d node-hunts. Fifth rule (U): never birth 6d next to an occupied 5f (fails even staged); converge the same-charge f-free d state first and birth 5f beside the real 6d instead -- downstream d-carriers then descend birth-free.
